items.title: ‘He was heartbroken’: My husband’s kids never helped when he was gravely ill. Was he right to leave everything to me?
items.description: “In the end, he left them a few sentimental mementos, some collectibles and old photographs.”

items.title: Here’s when Binance plans to reopen after what’s believed to be the largest-ever $6.3 billion hack
items.description: Binance has vowed to get the exchange back up within a couple of days after a record $6.3 billion heist, which has rattled the industry and investors.

items.title: Why Intel’s stock is sinking toward its worst drop in two years
items.description: Intel’s PC business is under pressure as memory-chip prices dent demand and as corporate IT teams have less budget for laptops.

items.title: My father has early Alzheimer’s and his caregiver is using his debit card for DoorDash. What can I do?
items.description: “I suspect the live-in caregiver is benefiting from my parent’s generosity.”

items.title: Solidcore founder Anne Mahlum plans enormous 10-bedroom ‘dream home’
items.description: Solidcore founder Anne Mahlum is thinking big for her next home—a sprawling, 10-bedroom property designed around entertaining, family life, and her love of staying in.

items.title: What gave this city its ‘best place to retire’ crown? You can actually afford to live there.
items.description: Low cost of living, high quality of life and favorable taxes for retirees, for the win.

items.title: Amazon’s stock drops — even in the face of a bold new cloud forecast
items.description: Modest AWS results and weak advertising growth left Wall Street disappointed in Amazon’s third-quarter earnings

items.title: A Starbucks turnaround is brewing — but perhaps not quickly enough for investors
items.description: The coffee chain beat expectations on a key sales metric, but its stock was still moving lower.

items.title: Sandisk sees revenue nearly quintuple — and a stock split is on the way
items.description: Sandisk’s stock has climbed more than 2,600% since the company separated from Western Digital 20 months ago — and it has one of the highest prices in the S&P 500.

items.title: Our church has a $1.5 million bequest earning 3.75% in a bank account. Is inflation eroding it?
items.description: “Given the size and long-term nature of this gift, we want to make sure the funds are managed prudently.”
